description: A single rolling window spikes well past the degrade threshold, then immediately returns to baseline.

timeline.note: single-window spike: p95 ~= 94ms, inflation ~= 74ms, well past degradeInflationMs

expectedStates.reason: the 60-70s window alone exceeded degradeInflationMs, but degradeSustainedWindows requires 3 consecutive violating windows, not 1 — must NOT transition to degraded
fully recovered; the spike left no lingering state

notes: This is the hysteresis/false-positive guard case named explicitly in TASKS.md PP-005's acceptance criteria. If an implementation reports degraded at any point in this timeline, degradeSustainedWindows is not being enforced as a consecutive-window counter (e.g. it may be using an any-window-in-history check, or a leaky/non-resetting counter).
